decisions.briefing: Markets were flat and directionless today (NASDAQ +0.4%, S&P 500 roughly unchanged), with no confirmed risk-on signal. None of the top screened candidates showed the full four-signal confirmation (MACD crossover, bullish-range RSI, price above SMA-20, and volume surge) needed for a high-conviction entry, so we're holding our 7 existing positions and keeping the remaining cash in reserve rather than forcing a buy.

market_education.summary_en: Today's trading was largely directionless, with the NASDAQ up a modest 0.4% and the S&P 500 essentially flat, suggesting investors are in a wait-and-see mode rather than reacting to any major catalyst. Without a clear risk-on or risk-off trigger, capital tends to stay parked in existing winners rather than rotating into new positions. This kind of quiet session often precedes a bigger move once new economic data or earnings news arrives.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大市走勢反覆,納指僅升0.4%,標普500指數則近乎持平,反映投資者處於觀望狀態,未見明顯利好或利淡消息帶動方向。在缺乏清晰風險偏好訊號下,資金傾向留在現有持倉而非追入新股。這類淡靜市況往往是醞釀較大波動的前奏,靜待後續經濟數據或業績表現。

daily_lesson.explanation_en: A 'risk-off' or neutral day is when the market shows no strong directional conviction, and the disciplined move is to hold rather than force new trades just to deploy idle cash. Chasing entries without full signal confirmation (like a volume surge alongside momentum indicators) increases the odds of buying into a false breakout.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 「風險規避」或中性市況,是指市場缺乏明確方向,此時較穩健的做法是持倉觀望,而非為運用閒置現金而勉強進場。若缺乏完整訊號確認(例如成交量放大配合動能指標),貿然入市容易誤墮「假突破」陷阱。
